subject: Kestrel Labs - press asset watermark / logo use exception on Order Form
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@kestrel.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@kestrel.ai>, procurement@kestrel.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: logo use & watermark allowance on Order Form

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about getting Redwood into our stack. Legal is working through the Order Form but we hit a snag around publicity and asset rules. Two items from our marketing team:

- Can Kestrel's logo be used in a short customer list reference on your website? We only need an attribution line.
- For press kits we sometimes need to provide a version of the Redwood-provided screenshot with a small watermark (company name + date) applied. Our legal team is asking whether that is permitted without an extra asset license in the Order Form.

We attached the Order Form v2 with our usual commercial edits (see attachment). Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts a limited watermark exception and provide the exact clause we should expect in the MSA/Order Form? If needed, we'll go through a quick legal review call.

Appreciate it — Elena

[Attachment: Kestrel_OrderForm_v2.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@kestrel.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: logo use & watermark allowance on Order Form

Hi Elena — great to hear and glad the demo landed.

Short answer: we can usually accommodate both a customer-reference line and limited watermarking for press kits, but we need to confirm the exact language and make a small Order Form exception to the standard publicity clause.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben and Kim — can you review Kestrel's attached Order Form and propose a short exception paragraph for publicity/logo use + watermark allowance? Prefer a single-sentence exception that can be appended to Section 7 (Publicity).
2) Elena / Tom — if you can confirm the watermark will be non-commercial (logo + small date stamp only) and include the intended channels (press kits, partner decks, Redwood website case listing), that will help legal scope the language.

I can host a 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize wording.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

[Attachment: redlines_msa.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed exception language for Kestrel Order Form

Marissa / Kim — first pass below. Kept it intentionally narrow:

"Notwithstanding the Publicity provisions in Section 7 of the Agreement, Redwood grants Kestrel Labs a non-exclusive, revocable license to add a small watermark (company name and date only) to any Redwood-provided screenshots or visual assets used solely for press kits, partner presentations, and Kestrel’s marketing website. Any such watermarking must not obscure product UI elements or alter Redwood branding. The parties agree that use in paid advertising or commercial resell collateral is not permitted without written consent."

Notes for legal:
- Keeps rights limited (no paid ads).
- Adds usability constraints (no UI obstruction).
- Suggest adding a 30-day notice right for revocation if Redwood identifies misuse.

Kim — can you confirm this is acceptable for us to propose in an Order Form addendum, and whether we should route via legal signature or a simple email concurrence?

Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elena Morris <elena@kestrel.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed exception language for Kestrel Order Form

Thanks Ben — wording looks fine to me with one tweak (adds revocation mechanics). Suggested final paragraph: 

"Redwood may revoke this limited watermark license upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Kestrel if Redwood determines, in good faith, that the watermarking is being used in a manner inconsistent with the restrictions herein. Revocation will not affect any uses already published prior to the effective date of revocation.

I recommend we add this as an Order Form Special Provision (short clause) rather than modifying the master MSA. For execution: Redwood legal prefers an email acknowledgment for Order Form addenda under $250k ACV, otherwise a signature page. Please advise on the contract value."

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morris <elena@kestrel.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@kestrel.ai>, procurement@kestrel.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed exception language for Kestrel Order Form

Thanks Marissa / Ben / Kim — that language looks great and the revocation clause is fine. A couple quick clarifications from procurement / marketing:

- Contract value is $115,000 ARR (annual subscription), so email acknowledgment should be fine.
- Watermarking use case: press kits and partner decks only; not for company homepage. We will keep the customer-list line minimal (single bullet: "Kestrel Labs") and will route any public case-study to Redwood for approval as usual.

Tom and I are available for a 20-minute sync today at 11:30 PT to finalize if that helps. Otherwise we can accept the clause as an Order Form Special Provision and confirm via email.

Best,
Elena
Head of Marketing, Kestrel Labs

[Procurement attachment: Kestrel_SOW_summary.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@kestrel.ai>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@kestrel.ai>, procurement@kestrel.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Order Form Special Provision & next steps

Elena / Tom / procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Kim's guidance and your confirmation:

1) We will add the Ben/Kim approved paragraph as an Order Form Special Provision (inserted after Section 7).
2) Because the ACV is $115k, Redwood legal will accept an email acknowledgment of the Special Provision (no separate signature page needed). Please reply-all with the following short acceptance: 

"Kestrel Labs accepts the Order Form Special Provision regarding limited watermarking and logo reference as drafted on Apr 5, 2028."

3) Once we receive the acceptance, I will attach the amended Order Form PDF and route for our internal countersignature. Expect a countersigned copy within 48 hours unless legal raises any follow-ups.

If you prefer the quick 11:30 PT call, Ben and I can join — send a calendar invite and we'll be there. Otherwise please confirm by email and we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
